name: web-industrial-catalog-ecommerce-monitor-mockup
title: Industrial catalog site shown on a monitor between dark rocks
whatItIs: A metal-supplier website on a tilted monitor against dark grey rocks. The UI has a top bar, search, a left category list, a large blue promo banner with steel pipes, and smaller tiles with glossy 3D icons for discounts, returns and delivery.
whatItMeans: Reliable, dense and practical, the kind of interface built for professionals who need to find things fast; the monochrome stage makes the blue pop.
techniques: Show a busy catalog UI in a monochrome stylised scene so the brand blue is the only colour.
Use glossy 3D icons in benefit tiles to add friendliness to a utilitarian page.
Keep a left category tree beside a hero banner to balance browsing and promotion.
Repeat one blue for banner, buttons and links.

vocabulary.definition: A site with a large hierarchical product list.
A small banner promoting one offer.
Presenting a design in a dramatic set.
